desc:
⚠️ [Beta Release]
This game is still under development. If you find any bugs or have suggestions, let us know in our community server!

Survive "Zombies", an action-packed FPS endless wave shooter where every round gets harder!

⚔️ Fight endless waves of zombies and see how long you can survive.
🔫 Upgrade your weapons to deal massive damage and stay alive longer.
💎 Earn Gems by defeating zombies and surviving waves.
🦸 Unlock powerful Classes, each with unique abilities that change your playstyle.
🏆 Beat your high score, play with friends, and become the ultimate zombie slayer!

Can you survive the endless horde?
